ph.quote: The raw materials for its production are milk cream ... and acidifying substances ... with a final pH ranging from 5.7 to 6.6

ammonia.reason: fresh unripened, no proteolysis/deamination to release NH3

animal_barnyard.reason: pasteurized cream, no p-cresol/indole from manure or washed-rind flora

bitter.reason: no rennet and no aging, negligible hydrophobic peptides

blue_moldy.reason: no Penicillium roqueforti, no methyl-ketone ripening pathway

browning.reason: residual lactose plus whey protein allows Maillard but diluted by high fat/moisture

buttery.reason: retained milkfat diacetyl/acetoin and C-delta-lactones from pasteurized cream

cheesy_sweaty.reason: minimal lipolysis in fresh curd, very low free C4-C6 butanoic/hexanoic acids

creaminess.reason: about 45% fat / 85% FDM emulsion stabilized by heat-denatured whey protein

crumbliness.reason: homogeneous high-fat gel, no calcium-paracasein matrix to fracture

firmness.reason: acid-heat thickened cream gel at 44-50% moisture, spoonable not cuttable

floral_honey.reason: low delta-lactones and benzaldehyde from cream fat, no concentrated terpenes

fruity.reason: trace 2-heptanone/2-nonanone and ethyl acetate from milk, no aged esterification

goaty.reason: cow cream only, no caprine branched C6-C10 fatty acids

malty_nutty.reason: no aging/proteolysis, negligible Strecker aldehydes like 3-methylbutanal

melt.reason: high moisture plus fat with weak whey gel slumps and fluidifies on warming

oil_off.reason: very high free milkfat coalesces to free oil when warmed

smoky.reason: unsmoked, no guaiacol/volatile phenols from smoking

sour_vinegar.reason: mild citric/acetic addition to pH ~6.0, no lactic fermentation

stretch.reason: no pasta-filata kneading, heat-precipitated whey cannot form aligned casein fibers

sulfur_cooked.reason: 85-95C cream heating denatures beta-lactoglobulin releasing H2S/sulfides

sweet.reason: high residual lactose and very low salt/low acidity enhances sweet perception

umami.reason: very low free glutamate, intact casein/whey with no ripened proteolysis
